description: This file is a Perl module implementing an interface to the Git version control system. It provides functions, classes, and methods to interact with Git repositories, execute commands, handle configurations, manage credentials, and perform various repository operations.

classes.name: Git::Error::Command
classes.description: An exception class representing errors from external Git commands, capturing command line, exit code, and output references.

methods.name: repository
methods.description: Constructs and initializes a new repository object, determining repository and working directory paths.

methods.name: command
methods.description: Executes a Git command with arguments, returning output as scalar or list depending on context.

methods.name: command_oneline
methods.description: Executes a command and returns the first line of output as a scalar.

methods.name: command_output_pipe
methods.description: Executes a command and returns a pipe for reading its output.

methods.name: command_input_pipe
methods.description: Executes a command and returns a pipe for writing input to it.

methods.name: command_close_pipe
methods.description: Closes a pipe obtained from command_output_pipe or command_input_pipe, checking for errors.

methods.name: command_bidi_pipe
methods.description: Executes a command and returns bidirectional pipes for communication.

methods.name: command_close_bidi_pipe
methods.description: Closes bidirectional pipes and waits for command completion, throwing on error.

methods.name: version
methods.description: Returns the current Git version.

methods.name: exec_path
methods.description: Returns the path to Git's executable directory.

methods.name: html_path
methods.description: Returns the path to Git's HTML documentation.

methods.name: get_tz_offset
methods.description: Returns the timezone offset from GMT for a given time or current time.

methods.name: get_record
methods.description: Reads a record from a filehandle delimited by a specified separator.

methods.name: prompt
methods.description: Prompts the user for input, honoring GIT_ASKPASS and SSH_ASKPASS env variables.

methods.name: repo_path
methods.description: Returns the repository path for a repository object.

methods.name: wc_path
methods.description: Returns the working copy path for a repository object.

methods.name: wc_subdir
methods.description: Returns the subdirectory within the working copy.

methods.name: wc_chdir
methods.description: Changes the subdirectory within the working copy.

methods.name: config
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration variable's value.

methods.name: config_bool
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean configuration variable.

methods.name: config_path
methods.description: Retrieves a path configuration variable.

methods.name: config_int
methods.description: Retrieves an integer configuration variable.

methods.name: config_regexp
methods.description: Retrieves configuration keys matching a regex.

methods.name: get_colorbool
methods.description: Determines if color should be used for a named operation.

methods.name: get_color
methods.description: Retrieves the color escape sequence for a given slot.

methods.name: remote_refs
methods.description: Fetches references from a remote repository.

methods.name: ident
methods.description: Retrieves and parses identification info (author/committer).

methods.name: ident_person
methods.description: Returns the person part (name and email) from ident info.

methods.name: hash_object
methods.description: Calculates the SHA1 hash for a given file considering its type.

methods.name: hash_and_insert_object
methods.description: Creates and inserts a Git object from a file, returning its SHA1.

methods.name: cat_blob
methods.description: Outputs the content of a blob object to a filehandle, returning size.

methods.name: port_num
methods.description: Converts port name or number to numeric port number.

methods.name: credential_read
methods.description: Reads credential key-value pairs from a filehandle.

methods.name: credential_write
methods.description: Writes credential key-value pairs to a filehandle.

methods.name: credential
methods.description: Handles credential operations, executing git credential commands.

methods.name: temp_acquire
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a temp file, locks it, and returns filehandle.

methods.name: temp_is_locked
methods.description: Checks if a temp file is currently locked.

methods.name: temp_release
methods.description: Releases a lock on a temp file or filehandle, optionally truncating it.

methods.name: temp_reset
methods.description: Resets (truncates and rewinds) a temp file.

methods.name: temp_path
methods.description: Returns filename of a temp file given its handle.

methods.name: prefix_lines
methods.description: Prefixes each line in a string with a given prefix.

methods.name: unquote_path
methods.description: Unquotes a c-escaped path string.

methods.name: get_comment_line_char
methods.description: Retrieves core.commentchar configuration or defaults to '#'.

methods.name: comment_lines
methods.description: Prefix lines with comment character based on config.

methods.name: _maybe_self
methods.description: Utility to determine if method was called on an object or class.

methods.name: _check_valid_cmd
methods.description: Validates a command name against a pattern.

methods.name: _command_common_pipe
methods.description: Backend to create pipes for command execution.

methods.name: _cmd_exec
methods.description: Executes a Git command within set environment.

methods.name: _setup_git_cmd_env
methods.description: Sets environment variables for Git command execution.

methods.name: _execv_git_cmd
methods.description: Executes the 'git' command with args.

methods.name: _is_sig
methods.description: Checks if a value is a specific signal.

methods.name: _cmd_close
methods.description: Closes pipes and throws error if command failed.

methods.name: END
methods.description: Performs cleanup at script termination, unlinking temporary files.
